name: market
description: Sales market of the weekly row: east or west; each market is one ordered weekly series

name: week
description: Week number since the start of the series (1..104 per market); the order of the adstock windows and the holdout cut

name: tv
description: Weekly television spend in dollars; carries over into later weeks

name: radio
description: Weekly radio spend in dollars; carries over into later weeks

name: search
description: Weekly paid search spend in dollars; carries over into later weeks

name: social
description: Weekly paid social spend in dollars; carries over into later weeks

name: price
description: Average shelf price in dollars for the week

name: promo
description: One when a promotion ran that week, else zero

name: sales
description: Weekly sales revenue in thousands; the response of the media-mix model
